reviews.body: ## ✅ Devin Review: No Issues Found Devin Review analyzed this PR and found no bugs or issues to report.

comments.body:
Real-device data for this, in case it helps review. No server kill needed: an ordinary network drop reaches the same path.

**Setup:** `livekit_client` 2.13.2, `flutter_webrtc` 1.6.3, local `livekit-server` in Docker. Full reconnect triggered by switching Wi-Fi off for 5 s and back on. Track state read with `ListParticipants` 12 s after the client was back in the room.

**Xiaomi POCO F1, Android 10, 10 Wi-Fi drops per condition:**

| Mic before the drop | `addTransceiver(): track is null` (unhandled) | Mic track after reconnect |
|---|---|---|
| live | 0/10 | live 10/10 |
| muted (`setMicrophoneEnabled(false)`) | 1/10 | muted 5/10, **not published** 5/10 |

Motorola g96, Android 15: the same unhandled exception on 2 of 5 Wi-Fi-off / airplane-mode reconnects (mic state not recorded).

Same stack as the issue (`_publishAudioTrack.negotiate` → `rePublishAllTracks` → `EngineRestartedEvent` handler), and it matches the muted-mic condition described there.

Two notes:
- Catching here fixes what hurts most in production: the error is unhandled (in our app, which reports unhandled errors through `PlatformDispatcher.onError`, it shows up as a **fatal** crash), and `RoomReconnectedEvent` never fires.
- In 5 of 10 muted runs the mic track was not republished at all, **with no exception logged**, so that looks like a separate path from the one this PR catches. Unmuting afterwards published the mic normally.
